spec.brief: Singular Value Decomposition function graph class

parameters.name: TT_DATA
parameters.description: describes the type of individual data samples input to the function.

parameters.name: TP_DIM_ROWS
parameters.description: describes the number of rows in the input matrix.

parameters.name: TP_DIM_COLS
parameters.description: describes the number of columns in the input matrix.

parameters.name: TP_PASSES
parameters.description: describes the number of Jacobi sweep passes (for convergence).

parameters.name: TP_CASC_LEN
parameters.description: selects the number of kernels the SVD will be split over in series.

parameters.name: TP_PASSES_SSR
parameters.description: selects the number of pass-pipeline stages. For values in the range [1, TP_PASSES], TP_PASSES must be evenly divisible by TP_PASSES_SSR and each stage performs TP_PASSES / TP_PASSES_SSR Jacobi passes. The additional value TP_PASSES + 1 is also legal. In that mode the first TP_PASSES stages perform one Jacobi pass each and the last stage performs no Jacobi pass; it is dedicated to singular-value extraction, U normalization, U/S/V sorting, and V compaction. This extra stage is intended as a final throughput optimization after the Jacobi loop has already been maximally distributed with TP_PASSES_SSR = TP_PASSES.

parameters.name: TP_DIAG_INV
parameters.description: selects singular values (0, default) or reciprocal singular values (1).

ports.type: input_port xf::solver::aie::svd::svd_graph< TT_DATA, TP_DIM_ROWS, TP_DIM_COLS, TP_PASSES, TP_CASC_LEN>::in
ports.name: in

parameters.description: Dimension of the square matrix A (= number of eigenvalues).

parameters.name: TP_PASSES
parameters.description: Maximum number of QR sweep iterations (with early exit once all eigenvalues have deflated). More passes improve convergence at the cost of latency.

parameters.name: TP_CASC_LEN
parameters.description: Must be 1.
